areas.limits: Pinned goldens plus seeded grammar-based exploration with bounded reduction of flags, patterns and subjects. Generated Linux x86 cases replay fully there; portable ASCII inputs replay elsewhere because upstream empty UTF matching differs by platform and PCRE2 JIT build configuration. Complete upstream dialect/JIT parity is not claimed. The pinned GNU/JIT Linux ARM64 and x86-64 PCRE empty-UTF output advances bytes; the pinned macOS ARM64 PCRE output advances codepoints. An oracle-independent CLI regression preserves that contract. The Linux musl/no-JIT release advances codepoints instead; the baseline/current/oracle comparison records this pre-existing difference.
Includes Git ignore/config, late NUL, transcoding and platform-specific contracts; exhaustive gitwildmatch/platform parity is not claimed.

areas.area: Python, Go and Rust source understanding
areas.limits: 328 upstream valid named trees; no macro expansion or semantic type resolution.

Labeled pinned production-source and synthetic fixture evaluations verify pipeline precision/recall and independent-line discovery, not live-model quality. Request/token/cost accounting supports explicit provider evaluations. Shared Typesafe and opt-in versioned Decision API contexts, per-region cache digests, and bounded cross-region line batches reduce transport/request overhead without skipping independent targets; fixture byte savings are not provider token-cost measurements. Completed negative line refinements do not fall back to coarse scores.

areas.area: Decision budgets, cache, retries and cancellation
areas.limits: Provider checks use HTTP/native fixtures. POSIX interrupt cancellation is cooperative; Windows signal behavior is not runtime-verified. Cached-only mode makes no provider calls and returns partial evidence on misses; rejects remote tables and external commands. Lazy shared local runtime, versioned per-score ages, bounded score table, parser-fingerprinted preparation cache and revision/permission scopes are fixture tested. Cache collisions are misses. Cross-file file/region/line batching supports finite budgets: one shared reservation per actual provider attempt, including retry/split attempts. Unranked unsorted discovery uses bounded queues and threshold-dependent inventory spill.

areas.status: native-server and fixture tested exact scan
areas.limits: Explicit ID ordering from page one; native-server pagination, concurrent writes, actual cursor expiry, large region lists, API-key revocation and opt-in certified-trigram candidates with legacy fallback. Snapshot-bound cursors and request/document/source/output budgets remain required. No connector ingestion or direct remote-file downloads. Proven regex substrings and bounded literal unions support conservative candidate pushdown. Transient per-table statuses inside HTTP 200 envelopes retry the same snapshot/cursor. Optional bounded prefetch overlaps one page with processing, preserves connection reuse across tables, and cancels on terminal budgets; quiet and finite match limits remain sequential. Native-server tests verify narrow metadata listing and lexical projections. Explicit lexical decision prefilters can use certified trigrams; unrestricted natural-language and reading-lead searches retain exact fallback. All finite decision request budgets keep foreground order.
JSON events expose schema version, provenance, source revision, index time, snapshot and observation time. Local sources are live; indexed sources represent stored revisions.

Paired elapsed/CPU/first-result measurements retain all trials and flag high variance. Native-instruction ARM64 Linux VM tests include cold advice, CPU affinity and worker sweeps on host-shared and container-local filesystems. Linux RSS uses separate GNU time command-maximum runs, not concurrent process-tree peak. Contended VM timings do not establish general Linux performance parity. Independent x86-64 hardware qualification remains admission-gated in CI; JIT growth requires a demonstrated bottleneck and equivalence evidence. Adaptive startup improves the measured small flat repository, but the larger SDK default remains slower than the saved baseline; explicit worker counts preserve eager startup. Earlier noisy and pre-workspace-correction reports remain available.

areas.status: bounded mutation and coverage fuzz campaigns
areas.limits: ReleaseSafe regex, Python/Go/Rust/JS/TS parser and dictionary targets have allocation/input/work bounds and leak checks; VM/JIT comparisons include spans, captures, marks, errors and steps. Finite campaigns are evidence, not a proof of safety for arbitrary input.

areas.status: bounded registered snapshots, exact incremental ranking and conditional/delta delivery; fixture tested
areas.limits: Explicit revision-pinned captures default to 256 MiB allocator memory and 100000 files; transactional recapture can retain two generations. Default discovery/reads are conservative. Opt-in bounded kqueue/inotify source and namespace/configuration journals cover ancestor paths, optional inputs, Git includes/HEAD and canonical symlink targets; complete clean coverage can skip discovery and opens, and unchanged captures retain the same generation. Missing subscriptions, loss/overflow, unsupported platforms, memory pressure or incomplete coverage fall back; force_rescan reads conservatively. Kernel-invisible mmap/remote writers still require forced capture. No live or globally atomic filesystem freshness claim. Ordinary queries preserve provider/auth/policy and oldest-evidence TTL semantics; partial results never become complete hits. Complete-query/file caches use four-way transactional admission with immutable leases; physical quota is released after backing frees. Existing optional cache caps are 16 MiB plans, 8 MiB file outcomes, 4 MiB queries and 4 MiB batch payloads, plus ordinary source/runtime/query memory. Eight immutable registered plans each cap owned compilation/options/delivery state at 2 MiB and exact positive/negative per-file outcomes at 4 MiB; one extra 2 MiB registration candidate is allowed before eviction, plus fixed owner headers. Handles avoid reparsing, recompilation and identity hashing; matching conditional hits avoid matcher cloning/cwd/provider setup. Exact score treaps and bounded changed-file workers promote prior losers and borrow unchanged winner payloads. Unsupported transformed inputs, finite global region budgets, skipped revision chains, stale evidence or index admission failure use ordinary search. Compact JSON defaults only for new registrations. Matching retained baselines can emit ordered delta/removal metadata and upsert payloads; clients commit only on complete successful end framing and retain only tokens actually received. Unknown baselines fall back to full delivery. Trim/forget/eviction retire handles. Idle service blocks on stdin, without polling/subscription promises. Native-fixture macOS measurements are not native Linux hardware, cold-cache, model-quality/billing or zero-resource-cost guarantees; full upstream regex/JIT parity remains unproven. Follow-up: complete-query hits cannot advance an unapplied registered file index. Source preparation is lazy, independently owned and peak-reserved against the workspace quota. Certified dirty refresh uses bounded watch-slot routing and transactional exclusive-owner updates to a canonical v2 Merkle tree; retained readers and uncertain coverage fall back. Ready byte accounting is cached. Immutable result payloads share the 4 MiB physical query-cache cap with metadata, constructors and active leases; delivery maps remove quadratic winner comparisons. Source work counters describe current invocation work. Paired selected-file edits improve end-to-end fixture latency about 1.4x; isolated search can be slightly slower as lazy parsing moves from capture into search.
